todos.detail: Round 2 after todo 4. Fixed 6 function-call array dereferences (PHP 5.4+) in kimi_goldmine_api.php via a goldmine_api_fetch_count() helper, and 13 multi-line short-array literals plus __DIR__ in check_dead_data.php. Deployed over FTPS after backing up the live files; download-back sha256 matched the repo for both. Verified by the host's own parser: both now emit runtime errors instead of 'Parse error'.

(a) kimi_goldmine_api.php requires findstocks/portfolio2/api/db_connect.php which is HTTP 404 on live AND absent from the repo at that path (only findstocks/kimis_claw/api/db_connect.php exists). (b) check_dead_data.php still ships template placeholders: db_user='root', db_pass='', db_name='your_database'. Both need real goldmines credentials, which supersedes/clarifies todo 5.

todos.title: Fix validate_php52.py false PASS
todos.detail: The gate reported 'passed: 7 file(s)' for two files that could not parse: its short-array regex forbade newlines so multi-line literals never matched, and it had no rule for )['k'] dereferencing. Rewritten to scan with a string/comment-aware tokeniser. Verified both ways: fixed tree passes 7 files, original broken files fail with 9 and 14 issues. Regression tests pin the false-PASS case.
